name: InputNumber field
summary: Type or step a number (decimals, negatives, min, max, step, precision) in the same field as Input, without antd.
highlights: A number field with the Input look, sizes and states
Exact decimal strings: no float rounding, empty is null
Min, max, step, precision, ▲/▼ stepper and arrow keys
lead: ONE custom element, <aha-input-number>, defined once and imported unchanged by React and Vue: the framework-free counterpart of antd InputNumber, so an app can drop antd for its number fields. It is the <aha-input> field (same tokens, small 24 · default 40 · large 48, error status, disabled, readonly, label, error and info message) holding a number. The value is a decimal string worked out with exact decimal arithmetic (0.1 + 0.2 is 0.3; a 20-digit id keeps every digit); empty is null and `valueAsNumber` reads it as a number. While typing, the value follows the text whenever it is a number inside min and max; on blur or Enter the text is committed: clamped, rounded to `precision`, and text that is not a number goes back to the last value. A hover-revealed ▲/▼ stepper (the InputNumber look) and ArrowUp / ArrowDown step it (Shift for ten steps). The inner field is the role="spinbutton"; the element is form-associated and <aha-form-item> reads, validates and resets it.
codeNote: antd InputNumber → <aha-input-number>: value / onChange → `value` (string, number or null) + the `input` event (fires on every value change, as onChange does; `change` fires on each commit or step), e.detail.value is a number, or a string under `string-mode`, or null when empty · stringMode → `string-mode` · min / max / step / precision → the same attributes (precision rounds half away from zero on commit) · controls={false} → controls="false" · placeholder → placeholder · status error/warning → status (warning renders as error) · disabled → disabled · readOnly → readonly · size small/middle/large → size small/default/large · prefix → prefix (text) · addonAfter → suffix (muted text unit after the stepper) · keyboard ↑/↓ and Shift ×10 → the same keys · onPressEnter → listen for keydown Enter (Enter commits the value) · aria-label / aria-labelledby → the same attributes, passed to the inner spinbutton · formatter / parser, decimalSeparator, changeOnWheel, hold-to-repeat on the stepper: not supported. React 18: set `value` through a ref (el.value = v, null for empty) and listen with ref.current.addEventListener('input', …), since React 18 does not wire CustomEvents; pass a boolean as present or absent ({...(disabled ? { disabled: '' } : {})}); disabled="false", readonly="false" and string-mode="false" read as off, and controls={false} renders controls="false", which hides the stepper. React 19 can use the element directly. Vue binds it natively (:value.prop, @input).

spec.label: Box
spec.value: the <aha-input> field: height 40 (default) · radius 8 · padding 0 8 0 12 · 1px #E3E3E3 (border-default) · 240 wide, full width in <aha-form-item>

spec.label: Sizes
spec.value: small 24 · default 40 · large 48 (16/24 text), radius 8; sm / lg accepted as aliases

spec.label: Hover / focus
spec.value: #E70E68 border on hover; focus #E70E68 border + 2px #E70E68@30% ring (focus-ring-soft), on the persistent wrapper

spec.label: Status
spec.value: error #1A1A1A border, 2px #1A1A1A ring on focus, aria-invalid; warning renders as error

spec.label: Disabled / readonly
spec.value: disabled #F1F1F1 fill, #EBEBEB border, no stepper · readonly #F7F7F7 fill, no stepper

spec.label: Text
spec.value: Plus Jakarta 14/21, tabular figures · placeholder #616161 (text-tertiary), as <aha-input>

spec.label: Stepper
spec.value: 18×14 ▲/▼ buttons (system-caret-up / down, 12px) 6px after the digits, #8A8A8A (icon-muted), hover #1A1A1A on #E70E680D (bg-accent), radius 4; shown on hover and focus (opacity), 11px tall in the small size; a button at the bound is disabled #B5B5B5; controls="false" hides it

spec.label: Affixes
spec.value: prefix (text, 4px before the digits) and suffix (a unit, 4px after the stepper), 14/21 #4A4A4A (text-secondary)

spec.label: Messages
spec.value: error-message: 12px system-warning-circle + 12/18 #1A1A1A text below, 4px gap · info-message: 12/18 #4A4A4A; both through <aha-field-error>

props.name: value
props.desc: The value. The property and attribute take a string or a number; the getter returns the decimal string ("12.5"), or null when empty. Set null or '' to empty it

props.name: valueAsNumber
props.desc: The value as a number; NaN when empty

props.name: string-mode
props.desc: e.detail.value (and <aha-form-item>'s value) is the decimal string instead of a number: for ids, money and values past 2^53 (antd stringMode)

props.name: min / max
props.desc: Bounds. Typing outside them leaves the value where it was until the field is left; blur or Enter clamps the text. The stepper button at a bound is disabled

props.name: step
props.desc: The step for the stepper and ArrowUp / ArrowDown (Shift steps ten times); a decimal step adds exactly

props.name: precision
props.desc: Decimal places: the value is rounded half away from zero on commit and the field shows that many places (1 shows as 1.00). A rounding that would pass max cuts the digits instead

props.name: placeholder
props.desc: Hint shown when empty

props.name: controls
props.desc: controls="false" hides the ▲/▼ stepper (antd controls={false}); the arrow keys still step

props.name: size
props.desc: small 24 · default 40 · large 48 (sm / lg accepted)

props.name: status
props.desc: Error border and ring plus aria-invalid; warning renders as error

props.name: error-message
props.desc: Shown below the field while status is error, linked through aria-describedby

props.name: info-message
props.desc: Help text below the field while there is no error

props.name: label
props.desc: Visible label above the field, a real <label for> on the inner field

props.name: disabled
props.desc: Not interactive, grey fill, no stepper; disabled="false" reads as off

props.name: readonly
props.desc: Shown but not editable, secondary fill, no stepper; readonly="false" reads as off

props.name: prefix / suffix
props.desc: Text before the digits (a currency sign) / a unit after the stepper (antd prefix / addonAfter)

props.name: aria-label / aria-labelledby
props.desc: Name the inner spinbutton; aria-labelledby ids are resolved to their text across the shadow root and re-read on focus. A <label for> on the host works too

props.name: aria-describedby
props.desc: Ids describing the field, resolved on the inner field

props.name: increase-label / decrease-label
props.desc: Accessible names of the stepper buttons, for a translated UI

props.name: inputmode
props.desc: Phone keyboard; by default decimal (numeric with precision 0) when min is 0 or more, else the text keyboard so a minus can be typed

props.name: name
props.desc: Form field name: the element is form-associated, submits the value ('' when empty), resets to its first value and follows a disabled fieldset

props.name: stepUp(n) / stepDown(n) / select() / focus()
props.desc: Step by n steps (clamped, fires input and change), select the text, focus the field

props.name: input
props.desc: Composed; fires on every value change: typing a number inside min and max, emptying the field, a step, or a commit that changes the value

props.name: change
props.desc: Composed; fires on each commit (blur, Enter) or step that leaves a new value

a11y.role: the inner <input> is role="spinbutton" with aria-valuenow (absent when empty), aria-valuemin and aria-valuemax; aria-invalid follows status
a11y.keyboard: ArrowUp / ArrowDown step, Shift steps ten times, Enter commits; the stepper buttons are tabindex=-1, so the field is one tab stop
a11y.note: The stepper buttons are named Increase and Decrease (increase-label / decrease-label).

whenToUse.when: a number in a product screen, filter or form: a score, an amount, a min and max range, with decimals or negatives
a slide type settings panel number with a unit (seconds, points): the settings control
an antd screen that already renders antd InputNumber and is not moving off antd yet

opinion.note: Set min and max to the real limits so the field constrains instead of validating after the fact. Use string-mode for ids, money and anything past 2^53. Label it with a noun phrase; a placeholder is not a label.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — the <aha-input> field chrome with the InputNumber stepper look from input-number.css (18×14 ▲/▼, icon-muted, bg-accent hover, revealed on hover and focus); sizes 24 / 40 / 48 and the error status as Input.
